Name: Yui Fujimori
Author: Lolsnaps
Description:
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53391/53391-1791141366-1420663959.png[/img]
[b][i]Yui Fujimori is a Japanese bookbinder who has moved into the little cottage beside the museum. She repairs books for Gunther, takes on her own orders, and has strong opinions about what belongs on a worktable.
She’s quiet with new people. Once she knows you, she’ll complain about dreadful mystery novels, dresses with impractical pockets, and the work she keeps meaning to put down before dinner.[/i][/b]

[b][i]She’s quiet with new people. Once she knows you, she’ll complain about dreadful mystery novels, dresses with impractical pockets, and the work she keeps meaning to put down before dinner.[/i][/b]
[heading][b][i][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53391/53391-1791141471-456377742.png[/img][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53391/53391-1791141474-1546419948.png[/img][/i][/b][/heading]
[i][b]Age[/b][/i][b][i]: [/i][/b][i]25[/i][b][i] · [/i][/b][i]she/her[/i][b][i]
Birthday: [/i][/b][i]Fall 12[/i][b][i]
From[/i][/b][i]: Hoshikawa, a Japanese coastal town[/i][b][i]
Work: [/i][/b][i]Bookbinding and book repair[/i][b][i]
Home: [/i][/b][i]A cottage in the museum-side lane[/i][b][i]
Arrival: [/i][/b][i]no earlier than Spring 8, and at least three mornings after adding the mod to your farm. You can start on an existing save.[/i]

Gunther gives her a place to work, Penny shares the library table, and Emily and Haley become close friends.[b][i]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53391/53391-1791141554-920914827.png[/img][/i][/b]
[b][i]Follow the road beside the museum and walk up the short side path into her lane. Her cottage has a bookbinding bench, drying shelves, shoji screens and a tatami corner for tea. Leave your shoes at the entrance.[/i][/b]
[b][i][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53391/53391-1791141568-2105766871.png[/img][/i][/b]
[b][i][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53391/53391-1791141663-1541202485.png[/img][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53391/53391-1791141674-679294690.png[/img][/i][/b]
[b][i]The workshop normally opens Monday, Wednesday, Thursday and Friday, 9 am–6 pm. An arranged visit or marriage also lets you in outside opening hours. [/i][/b]
[b][i][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53391/53391-1791141695-485044376.png[/img][/i][/b]
[b][i]Yui rotates between three everyday outfits each season, with different ways of wearing her hair. There are separate clothes for work, home, wet weather, dates, festivals and her wedding. [/i][/b]

[b][i][size=5]Spring[/size][/i][/b]
[b][i][size=5][img width=455]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53391/53391-1791141718-1591724894.png[/img] [/size]Loose hair, half-up styles and a low ponytail. [/i][/b]
[b][i][size=5]Summer[/size][/i][/b]
[img width=452]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53391/53391-1791141770-115121549.png[/img] [b][i]Lighter clothes, a high ponytail and a low bun. [/i][/b]
[b][i][size=5]Fall[/size][/i][/b]
[img width=450]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53391/53391-1791141804-153023413.png[/img] [b][i]Warmer layers, half-up hair and a side braid. [/i][/b]
[b][i][size=5]Winter[/size][/i][/b]
[b][i][img width=450]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53391/53391-1791141834-1791021535.png[/img][/i][/b]
[b][i]Coats and headwear, twin braids and a low twist. [/i][/b]

[b][i]Indoors, winter coats and hats come off. At home she has indoor footwear; outside in the rain she can carry an umbrella or wear her raincoat. [/i][/b]
[b][i][img width=391]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53391/53391-1791141869-435372234.png[/img][img width=390]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53391/53391-1791141884-622802233.png[/img][/i][/b]

[b][i][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53391/53391-1791141912-2097061318.png[/img][/i][/b]
[b][i]Yui works at the museum and her workshop, shops in town, walks by the water and spends evenings at the Saloon. On Thursdays she visits Emily and Haley. [/i][/b]


[b][i]You can help with cloth for a binding, a misplaced ledger and seasonal flowers for paper. She also has festival conversations and cinema reactions, and can join you for a film once the theatre is open. [/i][/b]
[b][i][img width=381]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53391/53391-1791141954-695442811.png[/img][img width=371]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53391/53391-1791141962-153072287.png[/img][/i][/b]

[b][i]Workshop requests[/i][/b]

[spoiler][b][i]Talk to Yui again after your daily chat and choose the work option when it appears. Requests unlock as her story progresses. Their details are also listed at the end of the event guide.[/i][/b]
[b][i][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53391/53391-1791142001-416163353.png[/img][/i][/b][/spoiler]

[b][i][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53391/53391-1791142022-568275080.png[/img][/i][/b]
[b][i]Yui’s friendship events follow her bookbinding work, life in town and family. Her full story is available without dating her. [/i][/b]

[b][i]Dating adds visits together and conversations about moving in. After marriage, Yui has her own room and patio, keeps her cottage, and continues working and visiting her friends. [/i][/b]
[b][i][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53391/53391-1791142049-2039770450.png[/img][/i][/b]
[b][i]Divorce and reconciliation are supported. Details are in the event guide. [/i][/b]
[b][i][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53391/53391-1791142061-1457941953.png[/img][/i][/b]
[b][i]Required: Stardew Valley 1.6 and SMAPI 4.5.2 or later. Checked with Stardew Valley 1.6.15 and SMAPI 4.5.2. SMAPI is the only required mod.
Current release: 1.0.0 Includes sprite eye refinements. Existing saves, configuration defaults and dependencies are preserved.
Downloads: Custom Music includes nine tracks made for Yui. Vanilla (Stock) Music uses the game’s soundtrack. Both include the same character content. Choose and install one edition.[/i][/b]
[list=1]
[*][b][i]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] if you do not already use it.[/i][/b][/*]
[*][b][i]Close the game and back up your save.[/i][/b][/*]
[*][b][i]Extract the download and put the single Yui Fujimori folder inside Stardew Valley/Mods. Keep its contents together.[/i][/b][/*]
[*][b][i]Launch through SMAPI and allow her arrival time to pass. Look for the path beside the museum.[/i][/b][/*]
[/list][b]Updating, removing or reinstalling Yui [/b]
[spoiler][b]Updating:[/b] close the game and back up your save and old Yui folder. Keep your config.json, replace only Yui’s folder, and restore your settings. Keep backup data outside Mods and leave only one Yui installation.
[b]Removing:[/b] Resolve any engagement or marriage, collect work payments, remove your belongings from her rooms and leave any active scene. Then Delete the mod from the Mods folder.[/spoiler]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53391/53391-1791142157-1265860677.png[/img]
[b]Stardew Valley Expanded 1.15.11 and East Scarp 3.0.9:[/b] her museum-side entrance and the separate route to East Scarp were checked together. You reach her home by walking through the normal overworld.
[b]Frontier Farm 1.15.11:[/b] her spouse room, patio, workday, return home and saved reload were checked on the standard layout.
[b]Polyamory Sweet Love 1.6.1:[/b] includes support for its detailed divorce form. Checked with one spouse; multi-spouse households have not been verified.
Mina Han is optional and adds three shared scenes.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53391/53391-1791142190-1442567524.png[/img]
[spoiler][b]Loves[/b]
Green Tea, Tulip, Cloth, Complete Breakfast.
[b]Likes[/b]
Rice, Goat Cheese, Coffee, Pink Cake, Milk, Honey, Strawberry, Blue Jazz.
[b]Neutral[/b]
Wood, Stone.
[b]Dislikes[/b]
Clay, Quartz, Copper Ore, Iron Ore, Gold Ore.
[b]Hates[/b]
Trash, Broken Glasses, Soggy Newspaper.[/spoiler]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53391/53391-1791142234-1615359048.png[/img]
The times below are [b]departure times[/b]; allow her time to walk. Festivals, rain, appointments and marriage can change the ordinary week.
[b]Monday[/b]
9 am: museum → 2 pm: workshop.
[b]Tuesday[/b]
10 am: Pierre’s → 12:30 pm: library → 3 pm: outside by the museum.
[b]Wednesday[/b]
9 am: workshop → 1:30 pm: museum → 4:30 pm: cottage.
[b]Thursday[/b]
9 am: workshop → 1:30 pm: Emily and Haley’s → 5:30 pm: cottage.
[b]Friday[/b]
9:30 am: museum → 2 pm: workshop → 6 pm: Saloon.
[b]Saturday[/b]
Spring and summer: beach from 10 am, Town from 2 pm. Fall: forest from 10 am, Town from 2:30 pm. Winter: library from 11 am, Saloon from 3 pm.
[b]Sunday[/b]
A day at the cottage, with time for reading, food and tea.
Most evenings end at the cottage around 8:30 pm, or 7:30 pm in winter. Bedtime is 10:30 pm.

[b][i]Rain, special dates and married routines [/i][/b]
[spoiler][b][i]Rain
[/i][/b][i]9 am: workshop → 1 pm: museum → 4:30 pm: cottage. Storms keep her at home.[/i][b][i]
Fall 12
[/i][/b][i]Her birthday is spent at the cottage.[/i][b][i]
Winter 9[/i][/b][i]
9:30 am: clinic → 2:30 pm: cottage. Married: returns to the farm from 3 pm.[/i][b][i]
Winter 16
[/i][/b][i]Workshop in the late morning, Night Market from 5 pm, home from 10 pm.[/i][b][i]
Fishing days
[/i][/b][i]Visits the Trout Derby from 10 am, returning from 4 pm; SquidFest from 11 am, returning from 3:30 pm.[/i][b][i]
After marriage
[/i][/b][i]Monday: museum from 9:30 am, cottage from 2 pm, farm from 5:30 pm. Thursday: cottage from 9:30 am, Emily and Haley’s from 1:30 pm, farm from 5:30 pm. Friday: museum from 9:30 am, cottage from 2 pm, Saloon from 6 pm, farm from 9:30 pm.[/i][/spoiler]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53391/53391-1791142307-281601580.png[/img]

[b]Workshop requests[/b]
[b]Q01 — A cloth binding sample:[/b] unlocked after Y02. Bring Cloth for the binding sample; the completed request pays 700g. It can be requested again after 28 days.

[b]Q02 — The other blue ledger:[/b] available after the introduction. Follow the request to find the ledger and return it to Yui. This is a one-time request, paying 400g.

[b]Q03 — Petals in the paper:[/b] unlocked after Y08. The requested flower follows the season: Daffodil, Sweet Pea, Fairy Rose or Crocus. This request can return after 28 days; check its conversation for the amount and payment.

[b]Breakup, divorce and a later conversation[/b]
Use the game’s relationship controls to separate. Completed friendship events stay completed. To ask about dating again, wait at least 14 days after separation, reach eight hearts and enable Romance. Your relationship with Yui must no longer be marked divorced, dating, engaged or married. Then choose “Talk about us.”[/spoiler]
